text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We're not doing any training today, are
we? I'll
be off, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As soon as we get back to the academy,
Aston
Machan hurries off somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping to discuss our upcoming
agenda...
but it looks like that's off the
table. Still, it's not
so urgent we can't
just talk about it tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For now, I go back and forth around the
academy
trying to get as many work
tasks done as
possible, until...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer? You're here? ...During the
stream?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Were you... unaware?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She hands me her phone and I see that
Aston
Machan is in the middle of an
emergency live
stream on UmaTube.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So... what's wrong all of a sudden? What
did you
call us here for?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to say my goodbyes. To Vodka,
to
Scarlet, to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'm quitting the Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'm going to switch to sprints.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: You look surprised.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course we're surprised. First of
all, there's
the distance issue, but also...

text_block_list.name: Scarlet and Vodka
text_block_list.text: After all that hype?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There was a storm of applause at the
Oka Sho.
Everyone there was
anticipating the next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She put out her challenge, honed her
skills to rise
to it, fired up the spectators
with those fighting
words, and then
dazzled at the Oka Sho.
choice_data_list: （何より、あんなに努力していたのに……）
choice_data_list_en: (Above all, after she worked so hard...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She'd crafted the whole plan to make
her victory
there even more
spectacular—to seize the Triple
Tiara so
vividly that nobody would ever forget

the day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Can she really be backing down this
casually?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...I realized as I was running. The finish
line felt so
far.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Maybe this is just a psychological thing
for me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But it does seem like 2,000 meters and
2,400
meters are a bit too long for me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I need a distance where I will stand out. I
want to
be a mascot, after all.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And since I haven't started
merchandising yet
either, I need to be
extra careful about which
steps I take
now.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So that's why I don't want to settle for
being the
moon—I want to go
somewhere I can be the sun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's smiling as usual, but there's a
subtle
difference in her tone of voice. I
remember where
I've heard it before.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I will become a super ultra mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'll definitely do it. No matter what.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well, that was my important
announcement.
Thank you for listening.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Machan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The stream goes quiet. The commenters
seem
confused.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But someone breaks the silence.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You are... SOOOO cool!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Where's all this coming from?! You're
gonna make
a snap decision and quit
just like that?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Forging your own path for your own sake! Nnngh! That's how I wanna do it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Vodka...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, you are right. Making decisions
like that
without hesitation is Machan's
strong point.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll miss you, but good luck! Let's
compete again
in the future!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet's
reactions,
the comments on the stream
begin to change.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"They're right." "I can't wait, Machan."

"Sprints are no walk in the park either."

"You can do it, Machan!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. You can all count on me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
My first big race after the summer will
be the
Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So I hope you'll look forward to seeing
me in that
race.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Machan. I was just wondering, but
your
trainer does know about all this,
right?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: So you didn't know after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She hardly ever comes to me to discuss
things, so
I can't say I'm surprised that
she made another
decision on her own.
But still...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Regarding Aston Machan... I say this
knowing that
you're better acquainted
with her than I am, but...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
She does have something of a tendency
to rush
into things.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she didn't withhold the
information from
you with any ill
intentions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not doubting her intentions. In fact, I
think
some of the blame might fall on me
for never
having thought to discuss
things with her.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Good. You're very positive, aren't you?
I'm glad
to see that.
choice_data_list: 頼れるトレーナーであれるよう、精進します
choice_data_list_en: I'll do my best to be a Trainer you can rely on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...So, next up is the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hope one day she'll choose to involve
me in her
plans.
